author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **Wormhole v3.3.0** — the ultimate cross-server relay!

Get started: `[p]wh create <network-name>` then `[p]wh open <network-name>` in channels you want to link.

Full help: `[p]wh help`
name: Wormhole
short: The ultimate cross-server message relay with DM relay, starboard, karma, auto-mod, polls, analytics & more.
description: Wormhole v3.3.0 connects Discord channels across multiple servers into named networks. Messages, edits, deletes, reactions, replies, stickers, pins, typing indicators, and files are all relayed in real-time via webhooks, embeds, or compact text. Features include: bidirectional DM relay, cross-network starboard, reputation/karma system, keyword highlight notifications, auto-moderation engine (spam/caps/invites/links/zalgo/raid detection), network invite codes with vanity URLs, staff announcements, persistent portal embeds, user profiles and stats, backup/restore, blackout scheduling, message search, scheduled messages, per-channel overrides, network discovery, relay delay, slowmode, purge, audit log, attachment filters, global blocklist, anonymous mode, one-way mirror channels, network-wide polls, AFK system, personal ignore lists, auto-responses, ephemeral messages, media-only mode, network analytics dashboard, relay health monitoring, message bookmarks, user vanity colours, quiet hours for DM relay, and inter-network bridging.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, guild IDs, and channel IDs for relay functionality. Per-user data includes message counts, karma scores, keyword highlights, DM relay subscriptions, bookmarks, AFK status, ignore lists, colour preferences, quiet hour settings, and analytics counters.
